decisions: Measured the exact reproducible v1.0.4 wheel in 10 fresh-process or PTY samples after 2 warmups; every unchanged product threshold passed.
Keystroke rendering stayed below the 50 ms threshold without weakening the gate.
limitations: Reference observation is macOS ARM64; the release workflow independently repeats the benchmark contract on Ubuntu before promotion.
result: Exact-wheel p95: version 35.704 ms, help 37.335 ms, 80x24 PTY prompt-ready 1083.561 ms, keystroke render 2.234 ms, offline doctor 3146.219 ms; every threshold passed.
